description:
Child of JMAP-sc1b.17. Add crate-jmap-mime/examples/parse_eml.rs that demonstrates the parse → message_to_jmap_body → body_value_to_jmap pipeline on a hand-supplied .eml fixture and prints the resulting JmapBodyFields shape. ≤ 40 LOC; no backend needed; mirrors the existing lib.rs doc-test.

Acceptance:
- examples/parse_eml.rs compiles and produces sane output.
- cargo run --example parse_eml -p jmap-mime succeeds.
- README.md for jmap-mime gains a one-line link to examples/.
- cargo fmt / clippy / doc gates remain clean.
title: Sub: examples/parse_eml.rs for jmap-mime
